## Golden Heart — community OC (name ambiguous)

The best-documented **pony** match is a brown male **alicorn** in early-2010s *My Little Pony* crossover fanfiction featuring Celestia and an alternate-universe Pinkamena Diane Pie, whom he calls his sister. Nicknamed **Goldie**, he initially looks like a pegasus under a hat and trench coat in *My Little Pony Goonies* before revealing his horn; that's a **disguise**, not a second individual.

**Appearance:** Brown coat; green/red mane; green/light-brown tail; golden-heart cutie mark. He wears gold chest armor, gold bracelets with green gems and silver anklets with green gems. [2012 character reveal](https://www.tapatalk.com/groups/lukesplace/my-little-pony-goonies-t549-s10.html).

**Naming:** In July 2012, fanfiction writer JusSonic recorded the change **Gold Heart → Golden Heart** while addressing DJ-J33. JusSonic said the OC belonged to another DeviantArt creator, but did not name that creator. [Contemporary author's note and story](https://www.tapatalk.com/groups/lukesplace/beauty-unicorn-and-the-demon-pony-the-enchanted-he-t534.html).

**Appearances/speaking:** He has written dialogue in *Beauty Unicorn and the Demon Pony* (2012), *My Little Pony Goonies* (2012), *Happy Birthday, Nyx* (2013), and *No Cupcakes With This Pinkie* (2014). These are **fan-written stories, not official TV episodes**. No recorded voice actor is verified; celebrity names in fanfiction credits are fancasting. [Happy Birthday, Nyx](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/144774/2/happy-birthday-nyx/chapter-2-the-love-of-a-birthday) · [No Cupcakes With This Pinkie](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/185655/1/no-cupcakes-with-this-pinkie/chapter-1-another-pinkie-pie).

**Name collision:** Artist **jucamovi1992 (Juan Carlos Morales Virano)** has a *different* Golden Heart, a green-skinned, yellow-haired female in an *Equestria Girls*-style fan comic, *The Friendship Cup*. The artist explicitly calls her their own character. The comic image below belongs to **this different OC**, not the alicorn. [Artist's character description](https://www.redbubble.com/i/art-print/Golden-heart-by-jucamovi1992/41200981/wqnt).

[![Different Golden Heart OC in a fan comic; art by jucamovi1992](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/10/5/1431537/full.jpg)](https://manebooru.art/images/1431537)

*Image provenance: artist **jucamovi1992**; originally uploaded by **Patometro06** in 2017, later imported to Manebooru by **booruimporter**. Neither art nor story establishes which Golden Heart the bare catalog slug intends.*
